questions.question: Chap table'dagi barcha row'larni, o'ngda mos kelmasa ham, qaytaradigan JOIN?
questions.explanation: LEFT JOIN chap tomonning hamma row'ini qaytaradi; o'ngda mos yo'q bo'lsa o'ng column'lar NULL bo'ladi. INNER faqat mos kelganlarini, CROSS Dekart ko'paytmani beradi. Tipik tuzoq: LEFT JOINdan keyin WHERE da o'ng table column'ini filtrlash uni amalda INNER JOINga aylantiradi — shartni ON ga qo'yish kerak.

questions.question: Natija nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: COUNT(*) row'larni sanaydi (3). COUNT(x), SUM, AVG kabi aggregatlar NULLni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi: COUNT(x)=2, SUM=4, AVG=4/2=2. Intervyuda ko'p so'raladi: AVG NULLni 0 deb hisoblamaydi — kerak bo'lsa AVG(COALESCE(x,0)).

questions.question: WHERE va HAVING farqi?
options: WHERE guruhlashdan oldin row'larni, HAVING guruhlashdan keyin guruhlarni filtrlaydi
WHERE aggregat funksiyalar bilan ishlaydi, HAVING ishlamaydi
questions.explanation: Mantiqiy tartib: FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT. Shuning uchun WHERE ichida COUNT(*) yozib bo'lmaydi, HAVING da esa mumkin. Performance maslahati: aggregatsiz shartni HAVING emas WHERE ga qo'ying — kamroq row guruhlanadi.

questions.question: employees(id, name, department_id, salary). 5 tadan ko'p xodimi bor bo'limlarni va xodimlar sonini qaytaring.
questions.modelAnswer:
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM employees
GROUP BY department_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
questions.explanation: Guruh bo'yicha shart — HAVING. Ko'p xato: WHERE COUNT(*) > 5 — bu xato beradi. Qo'shimcha: bo'lim nomi kerak bo'lsa departments bilan JOIN qilib, GROUP BY ga d.id, d.name qo'shiladi.

questions.question: SELECT NULL = NULL; nima qaytaradi?
questions.explanation: SQL uch qiymatli mantiqda ishlaydi: TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN. NULL bilan har qanday taqqoslash NULL beradi. Shuning uchun IS NULL / IS DISTINCT FROM ishlatiladi. WHERE faqat TRUE row'larni o'tkazadi — UNKNOWN tushib qoladi.

questions.question: DELETE, TRUNCATE, DROP farqi bo'yicha qaysi to'g'ri?
options: DELETE row'larni WHERE bilan o'chiradi (trigger ishlaydi); TRUNCATE hamma row'ni tez o'chiradi, struktura qoladi; DROP table'ni butunlay o'chiradi
DROP ni rollback qilib bo'lmaydi, DELETE ni ham
questions.explanation: DELETE qatorma-row, loglanadi, ROW triggerlar ishlaydi, sekin. TRUNCATE page'larni tashlaydi — tez, lekin kuchli lock oladi. DROP — table, index, constraint hammasi yo'q. Postgresda TRUNCATE va DROP ham transaction ichida rollback qilinadi (MySQLda DDL implicit commit).

questions.question: employees(salary) dan ikkinchi eng katta maoshni toping (takror maoshlar bo'lishi mumkin).
questions.explanation: Klassik savol. DISTINCT'siz ORDER BY ... OFFSET 1 xato beradi agar top maosh ikki kishida bo'lsa. N-chi uchun eng umumiy yechim: DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) = N. Ikkinchi maosh bo'lmasa MAX variant NULL qaytaradi — bu odatda kerakli xulq.

questions.question: PostgreSQLda natija tartibi qanday?
questions.snippet:
-- names: 'Ali', NULL, 'Bek'
SELECT name FROM users ORDER BY name;
questions.explanation: Postgres NULLni eng katta qiymat deb hisoblaydi: ASC da oxirida, DESC da boshida. MySQL/SQLite aksincha (NULL eng kichik). Aniq boshqarish: ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST / NULLS LAST. Index ham shu tartibda bo'lishi kerak, aks holda index ishlatilmasligi mumkin.

questions.question: UNION va UNION ALL farqi?
options: UNION dublikatlarni olib tashlaydi (sort/hash qiladi), UNION ALL hammasini qaytaradi va tezroq
UNION faqat ikki table bilan ishlaydi
questions.explanation: UNION = UNION ALL + DISTINCT, ya'ni qo'shimcha sort yoki hash. Dublikat bo'lmasligini bilsangiz (masalan turli sanalar oralig'i) doim UNION ALL — arzonroq.

questions.question: salary: 100, 100, 90, 80. Natija column'lari (rn, rk, drk)?
questions.snippet:
SELECT salary,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) rn,
  RANK()       OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) rk,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) drk
FROM emp;
questions.explanation: ROW_NUMBER — doim unikal ketma-ketlik (tenglarda tartib aniqlanmagan!). RANK — tenglarga bir xil raqam, keyin sakrash (1,1,3). DENSE_RANK — sakrashsiz (1,1,2). 'Top-N per group' da tenglar ham kirishi kerak bo'lsa DENSE_RANK.

questions.question: Har bir bo'limdan eng ko'p maosh oladigan 3 xodimni qaytaring. employees(id, name, department_id, salary)
questions.modelAnswer:
SELECT id, name, department_id, salary
FROM (
  SELECT e.*,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id
                            ORDER BY salary DESC) AS r
  FROM employees e
) x
WHERE r <= 3;
questions.explanation: Window funksiyani WHERE da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatib bo'lmaydi (WHERE SELECTdan oldin bajariladi) — shuning uchun subquery/CTE. Postgresda alternativ: LATERAL join bilan har bo'limga LIMIT 3 — (department_id, salary DESC) index bo'lsa juda tez.

questions.question: users(id, email) da takrorlangan emaillarni va necha marta takrorlanganini toping (katta-kichik harf farqsiz).
questions.modelAnswer:
SELECT LOWER(email) AS email, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM users
GROUP BY LOWER(email)
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY n DESC;
questions.explanation: Keyingi savol ko'pincha: 'dublikatlarni o'chiring, eng eskisini qoldiring' — ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(email) ORDER BY id) > 1 bo'lganlarni DELETE. Keyin UNIQUE INDEX ON users(LOWER(email)) qo'yib muammoni ildizdan yopish.

questions.question: banned(user_id) da bitta NULL qiymat bor. Natija?
questions.snippet:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM banned);
questions.explanation: id NOT IN (1, NULL) ≡ id<>1 AND id<>NULL → ... AND UNKNOWN → hech qachon TRUE emas. Mashhur tuzoq. Yechim: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM banned b WHERE b.user_id = u.id) — NULL xavfsiz va odatda anti-join sifatida yaxshi rejalanadi.

questions.question: posts(id, created_at, ...) — OFFSET 100000 sekin. Keyset (cursor) pagination bilan keyingi 20 ta postni oling (oxirgi ko'rilgan: :last_created, :last_id).
questions.explanation: OFFSET N hali ham N row'ni o'qib tashlaydi — O(N). Keyset indexdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri joyga sakraydi — O(log n). id tie-breaker shart, aks holda bir xil created_at'li row'lar tushib qoladi yoki takrorlanadi. Kamchilik: ixtiyoriy page'ga sakrab bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: key allaqachon mavjud bo'lsa, bu query nima qaytaradi?
questions.snippet:
INSERT INTO idempotency_keys(key, status)
VALUES ('abc', 'in_progress')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING key;
options: Hech qanday row (0 rows) — shu orqali 'men birinchi emasman' deb bilinadi
questions.explanation: DO NOTHING konfliktda row qaytarmaydi — bu 'lock olish' signali sifatida qulay. Mavjud row'ni ham olish kerak bo'lsa: DO UPDATE SET key = EXCLUDED.key RETURNING ... (lekin bu keraksiz yozish/dead tuple yaratadi) yoki keyin alohida SELECT.

questions.question: page_views(page_id PK, views) — bir vaqtda minglab query keladi. Hisoblagichni atomik oshiring (row bo'lmasa yarating).
questions.modelAnswer:
INSERT INTO page_views(page_id, views)
VALUES (:id, 1)
ON CONFLICT (page_id)
DO UPDATE SET views = page_views.views + 1;
questions.explanation: SELECT → UPDATE/INSERT ilovada race condition beradi. Upsert atomik. Staff davomi: juda hot row'da bitta row lock contention'ga aylanadi — yechim: counter'ni N ta shard row'ga bo'lib SUM qilish, yoki Redis INCR + davriy flush.

questions.question: Har foydalanuvchining oxirgi buyurtmasini olish uchun eng samarali usul (PostgreSQL)?
options: `GROUP BY user_id` bilan `MAX(created_at)` va keyin qayta JOIN

`DISTINCT ON (user_id) ... ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC` (PostgreSQL-specific, index bilan juda tez) yoki window funksiya `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1`; ko'p foydalanuvchi uchun `LATERAL` bilan index skip scan naqshi
questions.explanation: `(user_id, created_at DESC)` indeksi bo'lsa `DISTINCT ON` har guruhdan faqat birinchi qatorni o'qiydi. `MAX` + JOIN ikki marta skan qiladi va teng timestamp'larda dublikat beradi. Juda ko'p guruh bo'lsa `LATERAL` bilan 'loose index scan' (har user uchun LIMIT 1) eng tez variant bo'ladi.

questions.question: `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` da qanday nozik xatarlar bor?
options: Unique indeks aynan konflikt maqsadiga mos bo'lishi kerak (aks holda xato yoki kutilmagan yozuv), yuqori konkurentlikda deadlock/`tuple concurrently updated` bo'lishi mumkin, va `EXCLUDED` bilan yozilgan qiymat eski qiymatni shartsiz bosib ketishi (yaxshisi `WHERE` sharti bilan)
questions.explanation: Amaliy naqshlar: `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, email) DO UPDATE SET ... WHERE excluded.updated_at > t.updated_at` — kechikkan yozuv yangi qiymatni buzmaydi (last-write-wins'ni vaqt bilan boshqarish). Idempotentlik uchun ko'pincha `DO NOTHING` + keyin `SELECT` yetarli, va bu deadlock ehtimolini kamaytiradi.

questions.question: Unique constraint'da NULL qanday ishlaydi (PostgreSQL)?
options: NULL ham unique tekshiriladi, ikkinchi NULL rad etiladi
Default holatda har NULL o'ziga xos deb hisoblanadi — bir necha NULL qator qo'shilishi mumkin; PostgreSQL 15+ da `UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT` bilan bu xatti-harakat o'zgartiriladi
questions.explanation: Klassik bug: `UNIQUE (user_id, deleted_at)` bilan soft delete qilinsa, `deleted_at IS NULL` bo'lgan bir necha qator o'tib ketadi (dublikat faol yozuvlar). To'g'ri yechim — partial unique index: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ... ON t (user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`. Bu xulq DB'lar orasida farq qiladi, shuning uchun migratsiyada tekshiriladi.

questions.question: CTE (`WITH`) va subquery orasida ishlash farqi bormi (PostgreSQL)?
options: 12-versiyagacha CTE optimizatsiya chegarasi edi (har doim materiallashtirilgan); 12+ da oddiy CTE inline qilinadi, lekin `MATERIALIZED`/`NOT MATERIALIZED` bilan boshqarish mumkin — rekursiv yoki bir necha marta ishlatilgan CTE materiallashtirish foydali
CTE va subquery aynan bir xil
questions.explanation: Amaliy natija: eski loyihalarda 'CTE bilan optimizatsiya qildim' degan hiyla (planner'ni to'xtatish) 12+ da ishlamay qolishi mumkin va plan o'zgaradi. Agar CTE natijasi bir marta hisoblanishi kerak bo'lsa (qimmat agregat, keyin ikki joyda ishlatilsa) — `MATERIALIZED` aniq yoziladi.

questions.question: Window funksiya va `GROUP BY` farqi nimada?
options: `GROUP BY` qatorlarni birlashtiradi (natija qatorlari kamayadi); window funksiya har qatorni saqlab, uning yonida oyna bo'yicha agregatni beradi (`SUM(...) OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)`) — running total, reyting, oldingi/keyingi qiymat (`LAG`/`LEAD`) uchun
questions.explanation: Amaliy misollar: hisobdagi yurituvchi qoldiq (ledger `SUM() OVER (ORDER BY id)`), foydalanuvchi bo'yicha reyting, ikki hodisa orasidagi vaqt (`LEAD(ts) - ts`). Ishlash: window funksiya sort talab qiladi — mos indeks (`PARTITION BY` + `ORDER BY` ustunlari) bo'lsa sort tashlab ketiladi. Frame ta'rifi (`ROWS` vs `RANGE`) natijani o'zgartiradi — teng qiymatlarda `RANGE` hammasini qamrab oladi.

questions.question: `LATERAL` join qanday holatda kerak?
options: O'ng tomondagi subquery chap tomondagi qatorga bog'liq bo'lganda: har mijoz uchun oxirgi 3 buyurtma, har kategoriya uchun top mahsulot — ya'ni 'per-group LIMIT' naqshi
questions.explanation: Oddiy JOIN'da 'har guruhdan N ta' ni ifodalash qiyin: window funksiya bilan ham butun to'plam skanerlanadi, `LATERAL` esa har guruh uchun indeks bo'yicha faqat N qator o'qiydi — katta jadvalda bir necha tartib tez. Sintaksis: `FROM customers c, LATERAL (SELECT ... WHERE o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3) o`.
